tagline: Portable power stations, compared by what they actually cost per watt-hour.

collections.title: Best portable power stations under $500
collections.intro: Budget stations trade capacity for price. These are the models under $500, sorted by cost per watt-hour so you can see which ones give you the most stored energy for the money.

collections.title: Best portable power stations for camping
collections.intro: For weekend camping you want enough capacity for phones, lights and a small fridge without carrying a brick. Here are the lighter models, sorted by capacity.

collections.title: Best portable power stations for home backup
collections.intro: Home backup needs capacity and high output to run appliances through an outage. These models start at 1,000 Wh, sorted by cost per watt-hour.
